info.title: Impaqt API
info.description:
Integration reference for third-party developers (March 2026).

Auth: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Send `Authorization: Basic <client_id+client_secret base64>` and `Content-Type: application/json`. With `on_behalf` scope also send `grant-id: <grant_id>` (UUID from the grants endpoint). With `self` scope do not send it.

All responses use a standard envelope (timeStamp, statusCode, httpStatus, message, data, requestId, success).

post.description: Issues a bearer token via OAuth 2.0 client credentials. NOTE: the guide's heading for this endpoint is garbled; the path is taken from the Integration Flow table. The token response body is not documented in the guide; the fields below are standard OAuth 2.0 assumptions.

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Returns grants available to the authenticated client for on_behalf usage. Supported only for on_behalf tokens; no grant header required. (Guide example path: GET /agents)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Returns products assigned to the active grant, including plans and benefit metadata. IMPORTANT: each product's `id` is the UUID of the grant-product assignment record; use it when creating quotes. (Guide example path: GET /products)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

post.summary: Create quote for a grant product
post.description:
Creates and stores a quote for the specified grant-product UUID. `id` must be products[].id from the products endpoint. (Guide heading shows /IMPAQT-API-create-quote and the example path POST /products/{id}/quote; `{id}` placement is inferred.)

Validation: plans must be non-empty; plan_id integer; principal >= 1; counts non-negative integers; duplicate plan_id rejected; if product does not allow mixed plans only one plan may be submitted; dependant counts must not exceed configured maximums unless extra dependants are allowed.

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Returns a paginated list of policies created under this grant, filtered within the authenticated aggregator context. The guide documents this path twice (sections 5 and 10) with different filters; they are merged here. `no_of_lives` counts principal members only. An unknown customer_id returns an empty list, not an error.

parameters.name: id_passport_reg_no
parameters.description: Filter by ID / passport / registration number

data.description: Paginated policy list (schema not specified in guide)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Returns policy benefit names (section 6) and full details for a single policy including invoices, members, plans (with full pricing breakdown) and claims (section 11). The guide documents this path twice; merged here.

data.description: Policy detail (schema not specified in guide)

404.description: Policy does not exist within this grant's scope

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

post.description: Registers a customer and links them to the authenticated third-party client. Returns a UUID for future reference. If the customer already exists they are linked and the same UUID is returned (200). Accepted file types: JPEG, PNG, PDF only.

200.description: Customer already onboarded; linked to client (same UUID)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

post.description: Converts a previously created third-party quote into a policy and creates the first invoice. Enforces strict validation against the quotation payload. policy_end_date is auto-derived (policy_start_date + plan duration_months). (Guide example path: POST /policies/from-quote)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.summary: List tracked invoices for a policy
get.description: Returns invoice tracking records for the given policy number, scoped to the authenticated client and grant. Supports policies with multiple invoices. (Guide example path: GET /policies/{policyNumber}/invoices; passed here as a query parameter because the gateway heading carries no path variable.)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Returns available loss events and their natures of loss, including required document types per nature. (Guide example path: GET /claims/events)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on loss event name (alias: searchTerm)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

post.description: Creates a claim for a tracked third-party policy and records claimed benefits. Validates policy ownership, risk membership, nature of loss and required documents. (Guide example path: POST /claims)

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

post.description: Uploads documents for a previously created claim. Each multipart file key must be the numeric document_type_id (e.g. `201=<file>`). Rules: claim must belong to the authenticated grant; each document_type_id must be valid for the claim's nature of loss; all mandatory documents must be present (existing + current upload); allowed types JPEG, PNG, WEBP, PDF. (Guide example path: POST /claims/{claimId}/documents)

parameters.name: claimId
parameters.description: Claim UUID returned by the submit-claim endpoint

schema.description: Property names are numeric document_type_id values

404.description: Claim not found within this grant's scope

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

get.description: Fetches a claim using the claim UUID returned by the submit-claim endpoint.

404.description: Claim does not exist within this grant's scope

403.description: Scope or grant not permitted for this client

basicAuth.description: Base64 of client_id:client_secret as documented in the guide

GrantId.name: grant-id
GrantId.description: Required for on_behalf scope; must be the grant_id UUID from the grants endpoint. Omit for self scope.

Scope.description: self: client acts only for its own assigned agent (no grant header). on_behalf (preferred): client acts for one of several grants (grant-id header required).

Error.description: Error envelope. Common messages: Invalid client credentials; Client is not allowed to use scope on_behalf; Grant header is required for on_behalf scope; Client is not allowed to use the supplied grant id; Grant product was not found for the supplied grant; plans must be a non-empty array; plans[0].plan_id must be a valid integer; plans[0].principal must be at least 1; One or more selected plans are invalid for this product; This product does not allow mixing multiple plans in one quote; Duplicate principal_national_id values found: ...; Quoted count mismatch for plan ...; policy_number is not accessible for this grant; nature_of_loss_id is invalid for the supplied loss_event_id; Missing required documents for selected nature_of_loss: ...

id.description: Grant-product assignment UUID; use when creating quotes

plan_id.description: Plan ID from the products endpoint

idFront.description: Front of national ID or passport (JPEG/PNG/PDF)

national_id.description: Dependant ID (birth certificate number for minors)

principal_national_id.description: Principal ID/Passport; must be unique across all risks

plan_id.description: Required when the quote contains multiple plans

quote_reference.description: Quote reference from the create-quote endpoint

customer_id.description: Third-party customer UUID from the register-customer endpoint, or internal numeric ID

nature_of_loss_id.description: Must belong to the selected loss event
